checks.claim: The 2024 law directed NRC to produce microreactor-specific licensing strategies across eight areas (done, January 2026) and cut the hourly rate advanced-reactor applicants pay for review from $318 to $148, a concrete cost advantage available now.
checks.evidence: NRC's FY 2026 final fee rule (Federal Register 2026-12067, published 2026-06-16, effective 60 days later) sets a reduced hourly rate of $154 for advanced nuclear reactor applicants and preapplicants, with a professional rate of $337. The $148 rate was the FY 2025 rate, effective 2025-10-01. ANS (2026-06-25) reports the FY 2026 fees; SMR Intel (fetched) states the $154 rate and the June 16 publication date.
checks.correction: The 2024 law directed NRC to produce microreactor-specific licensing strategies across eight areas (done, January 2026) and cut the hourly rate advanced-reactor applicants pay for review from $318 to $154, a concrete cost advantage available now.
